Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift · 3 sets × 8 reps per leg; keep your hips square and core engaged throughout the movement.
Pistol Squat Progression · 3 sets × 5 reps per leg; lower down slowly using a box or suspension strap for support if needed.
Bosu Ball Squat · 3 sets × 10 reps; maintain a stable center of gravity and look straight ahead.
Single-Leg Overhead Press · 3 sets × 8 reps per arm; engage your stabilizers to prevent torso rotation.
Farmer's Walk on Toes · 3 sets × 30 seconds; keep your posture tall and heels elevated for ankle stability.
